description_expanded: Nestled along Scenic 30A, just three blocks from the pristine beach, Buddy Street Retreat is a stunning, nautically inspired three-story vacation home designed for unforgettable coastal escapes. With six bedrooms, multiple beds and bunks, and accommodations for up to 18 guests, this retreat is perfect for large gatherings of family and friends. Plus, it’s pet-friendly, so your four-legged family member can join in on the fun! A Natural Coastal Paradise Tucked between the shimmering emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico and the rare, scenic beauty of Draper Lake, this rental home is surrounded by nature’s finest treasures. Coastal Dune Lakes like Draper Lake are incredibly rare, found in only a few places worldwide, and create a mesmerizing blend of spring-fed freshwater and salty Gulf tides. The estuary where the lake meets the Gulf offers a unique ecosystem, attracting an array of wildlife, from Great Blue Herons and Snowy Egrets to majestic Ospreys. A short stroll down the sugar-white sands leads to this enchanting waterway, where you can paddleboard, kayak, or try your luck at fishing. Private Pool & Outdoor Entertainment Beyond the beach and lake, the private lagoon-style pool is a serene escape, surrounded by lush landscaping, towering magnolias, and tropical palms. The sun-soaked patio is furnished with lounge chairs, perfect for soaking up the warm Florida sunshine. Multiple levels of expansive decks overlook the pool, providing ample space for outdoor dining, relaxation, and entertaining. The lower level features a built-in bar and a gas grill, making it an ideal spot for poolside cookouts and evening cocktails under the stars. Spacious & Stylish Interiors Designed with multiple families in mind, this home offers two separate living areas and guest quarters across all three levels. The first floor features a poolside family room with a cozy wraparound couch and a large flatscreen TV, perfect for movie nights. A built-in bunk area comfortably sleeps 12 guests in crisp white bunks, ideal for kids or young-at-heart travelers. The locker-room-style bath includes a tub/shower combination. A private king bedroom on this level boasts a plush suede headboard, flatscreen TV, outdoor access, and an ensuite bath with a walk-in shower. The main living area on the second floor is bright and airy, with soaring white-beamed ceilings and a breezy coastal aesthetic. A plush wraparound sofa and armchair face a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV, creating a welcoming space for gathering. The adjacent dining area features a rustic wood plank table with a unique shell chandelier above, while three vintage-modern metal stools sit at the quartz-topped bar. The fully equipped chef’s kitchen offers cream-colored custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and everything needed for home-cooked meals. The primary suite on this floor is a sanctuary, featuring a king-size bed, a cozy seating area, and private deck access. The spa-like ensuite bath is adorned with veined marble, double vanity sinks, and a luxurious walk-in shower. The third floor includes two well-appointed guest bedrooms, each with a king-size bed, that share a stylish hall bath with a walk-in shower. Close to Gulf Place & 30A Hot Spots Just a two-minute drive away, Gulf Place serves as the heartbeat of Santa Rosa Beach, offering a vibrant mix of restaurants, bars, an ice cream parlor, a coffee shop, and boutique shopping. This charming coastal village is centered around a Royal Palm-lined amphitheater, hosting live music, art shows, and seasonal festivals. Named one of Travel & Leisure’s Top 5 Favorite Beach Towns, Gulf Place embodies the laid-back luxury of 30A. Whether you’re lounging by the pool, exploring the beach and lake, or indulging in the vibrant local scene, Buddy Street Retreat delivers the ultimate blend of relaxation, adventure, and coastal charm. Book your stay today and experience the best of 30A!
